datasets.notes: IMPORTANT VINTAGE CAVEAT: This is the CBO 2021-vintage report (publication 60341, 'The Distribution of Household Income, 2021'), covering 1979-2021, NOT the requested 2022-vintage report (publication 61911, 'The Distribution of Household Income, 2022', covering 1979-2022, published Jan 2026). The 61911 report's supplemental-data/data-underlying-figures/researcher-data files could not be located at any guessed or discovered URL after 25+ attempts (all returned genuine HTTP 404 via fetch_url) despite the CBO publication page and the CBO 'Publications With Supplemental Data Files' index (https://www.cbo.gov/data/publications-with-data-files) both confirming such files exist; CBO likely serves them via a JS-rendered link that this tool environment's fetch_url could not resolve to a raw asset URL, and cbo.gov/system/files/* is blocked to direct curl/wget by Datadome bot protection. The 2022 report HTML full-text page (https://www.cbo.gov/publication/62300) was also checked and contains only chart images/narrative, no embedded numeric tables. All dollar figures are in 2021 dollars (not adjusted to 2022 or current dollars). Values were extracted via fetch_url's LLM-assisted xlsx reading (sheet-by-sheet) since direct curl downloads of cbo.gov/system/files/* xlsx assets are blocked; every value below should be treated as transcribed from that extraction and spot-checked against the source if used for critical purposes.

notes: See per-dataset 'notes' field for the critical vintage caveat: this file contains the 2021-vintage CBO Distribution of Household Income report (1979-2021), not the requested 2022-vintage report (1979-2022, publication 61911). Gini coefficients are not published in the CBO supplemental-data workbook (CBO shows Gini only as a chart in the report PDF, with no accompanying data table found); gini is null throughout. Dollar percentile thresholds (p10, p50, p90, etc.) are not published by CBO in this supplemental file either - CBO publishes quintile/percentile-band AVERAGES (not thresholds), stored here under a supplementary 'quintile_averages' field per year, plus 'quintile_shares_pct' and top1_share under 'top_shares' for the two national-income definitions. All dollar values in 2021 dollars.
